description: Turn the workspace’s live iCalendar (.ics) and Google Sheets (.csv) subscription feed on or off, or rotate its secret token (Studio and Pro). Ask the user before rotating, because rotating breaks previously subscribed calendar links.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

enabled.description: true turns the live .ics and Google Sheets .csv subscription feed on; false turns it off.

rotate.description: true generates a fresh secret feed token and immediately invalidates the old feed links.

name: calendars_feed_set
title: Configure live calendar feed
